lyrics:
(The Beat Asylum)
Come through off and proceed with caution or suffer it
All you niggas barking not bitin', y'all on some other shit
See me I'm an Alien nigga, I'm from a mothership
I'm tryna get richer than Richie then fuck yo' mothers shit
Go over it then go off it, I put the shit in the coffin
I'm sippin' lean I ain't coughing, I swag on this bitch too often
Yo' bitch ain't with the talkin', so I'ma love her regardless
These niggas ain't shit but ho's, they run away when I spark it, ha
Ain't with the back-talk, got a MAC in the stash box, better back up
I'm in the trap spot, got a dome with a padlock, wippin' crack up
I let the MAC bust, if a fuck nigga act up, so don't act up
Fuckin' on yo' ho, gimme a minute, money in my pocket I've been spendin'
Pull up on 'em, drive Bugatti engine, I'm with niggas, yeah, I got some henchmen
Crew so damn smooth twelve came 'round ain't know a nigga did it
Hold up, bae gimme a minute, I'm tryna hit it and quit it, I'm tryna hit it and hit it
I'm tryna hit it then pop a Xanax then maybe even forget it, ha
All these niggas talk about is everything they finna do
Only thing a nigga like me hears what you didn't do
Me and you, we not alike, so I don't sit wit' you
Them bad hoes don't want you, my nigga, they ain't into you
Cali plug got the p's, I'm the one they send 'em to
Young boy line bussin', he the one I give 'em too
Say you finna ride boy, what you wanna get into?
I am not the one and you don't wanna make this physical
You don't want issues with a criminal, keep yo' comments to a minimal
Make dollars with decimals on them digitals
All I wanna do is go shopping like its a ritual
Leave a legacy for my lady and all my children too
But these nincompoops think that we won't shoot
These bullets flyin' out of nowhere like Beatle Juice, Beatle Juice, Beatle Juice
Nobody lived to see the sequel through, if you do, you definitely shitting in a bag and probably eating through it too
